13.SC/ST/OBC (Non-creamy Layer) candidates must enclose with the application a hard copy
of the Caste Certificate/Income Certificate in the prescribed Format of the Government of
U.P., duly issued by the Competent Authority.
14.EWS candidates are required to submit a certificate in the prescribed format of the
Government of U.P., duly issued by the Competent Authority.
15. A candidate already in employment is required to submit the ‘No Objection Certificate’ at
the time of submitting online application form or at the time of interview.
16.Experience and Qualifications shall be reckoned as on the last date of submission of
application form.
17.Recruitment process shall consist of three parts (i) basic academic score, (ii) proficiency
test, and (iii) interview.
18.No T.A./D.A. shall be admissible for attending the interview.
19.No ‘Interim Correspondence’ shall be entertained.
Important Dates
S. Particulars Date
No.
1. Date of opening of the online application form 26/09/2026
2. Last Date for submission of the online application 31/10/2026
3. Last date for receiving hard copy of Application Form 07/11/2026
Other instruction:
A. How to Apply: The duly filled-in-application in the Prescribed Format shall be submitted online.
B. Application Fees: Candidates have to pay application fee Rs. 2000/- (Rs. 1500/- for SC/ST
candidates only) fee through ‘Online Transaction’ along with online application.
C. Documents required to be submitted with the Online Application:
i. Candidates are advised to upload a merged single PDF file for Marksheets and
Certificate/Degree for respective educational qualifications, wherever required.
ii. Candidates should submit a PDF containing scanned copies of all the supporting
documents in support of the claims made in the Online Application, viz Eligibility,
Experience, Achievements etc. (each page duly signed).
iii. Other documents can be uploaded in “Other” section”.
iv. The University shall get verified all the documents in support of qualifications, experience
etc. submitted by candidate, from the issuing authority. If any document is found to be
false/fake/incorrect at any stage of verification before or after appointment, the document
in question shall lead to termination of his/her appointment.

v. While filling online application form candidates are suggested to fill absolute numerical
values rather than in decimal or in fractions.
vi. The application process is online only but candidates are required to submit the hard
copy of the duly filled application form along with supporting documents (each page duly
signed) by Registered post/Speed post to The Registrar, Chhatrapati Shahu Ji
Maharaj University, Kalyanpur, Kanpur – 208024 (U.P.) so as to reach the University
office on or before 07 November 2026. The envelope on its top shall mention the
advertisement number and post applied for.
Note: Once the application is finally submitted, no changes/modifications in the data shall
be permitted. Therefore, candidates are advised to carefully verify all entries before final
submission.
(Registrar)
Programmer

Subject) or equivalent higher qualification from a recognized
University/Institution or M.C.A./M.Sc. (Computer Science or related
Subject) from a recognized University/Institution or Second Class
Bachelor degree from a recognized University with 'B' level Course
Certificate from DOE. At least 02 years of experience in software
development.
Desirable: Complete Knowledge of office automation packages and
internet. knowledge of Website management and data management.
Knowledge of programming languages Java, Python, C, Ruby, HTML/CSS,
PHP. Experience in developing tools/application which interact with web-
based services, tools, and databases, and using APIs. Skill of developing
mobile operating systems based Apps. Server handling abilities.
